title: Spectrogram fixes (loading indicator, only-last-frame render, settings overlay 'Параметры')

decisions.text: Scope & process: 3 items -> 3 phases. Per-step atomic commits (step-id prefixed, Co-Authored-By); NO push; phase-boundary pauses; vue-tsc + bun green each step. Code in GnauralCore; ledger in MindWaveCore.

Loading indicator: surface worker/tile loading in SpectrogramView as an overlay spinner driven by spec.loading (analysis open + tiles pending); keep audio.spectrogramLoading (decode) in AudioPage so an indicator covers the whole prepare span (decode -> open -> first tiles).

Only-last-frame fix: make the rendered tile set persist/accumulate during load: (a) guard setView/applyView to no-op when the effective view (time window + zoom + viewBinCount) is unchanged (kill viewSeq churn); (b) re-assembleVisibleTiles on every tile arrival against the current cache (not only when pending.seq===viewSeq); (c) final assemble+redraw when loading clears. Root cause confirmed at execution via instrumentation; add a composable unit test for tile accumulation across a binCount/seq change. Confirmed repro (owner): happens on OPEN, no playback; a one-tile strip runs L->R and only the last tile stays.

Settings panel = overlay named 'Параметры': convert the fixed 264px side column into a toggleable overlay mirroring the schedule settings panel (absolute aside over the plot, no main-content resize, backdrop, <transition>); header title 'Параметры' (audio.spectrogramSettingsTitle: en 'Parameters' / ru 'Параметры') + close (x). Default closed.

Toggle placement: the 'Параметры' toggle lives in the SpectrogramView toolbar (next to zoom/fit); open/close state + overlay are self-contained in the view; state local (not persisted) unless owner asks otherwise.

Owner addition 2026-07-01 (Audacity-like UI #1): give the spectrogram plot a taller default height matching the Audacity reference (per-channel ~240px; stereo split ~2x) instead of the current min-height:280px flex fill.
Owner addition (Audacity-like UI #2): a drag handle on the bottom border of the spectrogram track resizes its height via pointer drag (like Audacity); persist the chosen height (localStorage).

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 10 item 1): render one shared header bar above the first track holding ALL control buttons (zoom in/out, fit); buttons leave the per-track toolbar and exist once for the whole spectrogram.
Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 10 item 2): the L label sits in the SAME place as R - a top-left corner overlay on the plot, not in the toolbar. Both channel labels become plot overlays.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 10 item 3): the horizontal time ruler is drawn only above the first track and below the last track (middle tracks carry no time ruler when >2). The vertical frequency axis stays on every track.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 10 item 4) DECIDED: move the timespan selector out of the header to a fixed bar at the very bottom of the spectrogram window (position fixed). Owner chose a FULL minimap-style overview (canvas overview + draggable/resizable visible-window handle) modelled on the schedule view 68px bottom minimap - NOT a relocated q-range slider. Readout moves to a cursor tooltip (SF-D25) so the header holds only buttons.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 10 item 5): remove the 'Спектрограмма' subtitle (audio.spectrogramTitle, text-subtitle2) shown between the Старт/transport toolbar and the plot in the spectrogram tab.

Owner addition 2026-07-03 (Phase 11 item 3, step 2) DESIGN awaiting go: Audacity-style display-resolution STFT. Root cause (measured): the worker computes the FULL-res STFT for a tile's whole span (e.g. 171144 FFTs for a 33-min overview) then max-pools -> cold overview ~3.9s; zoom/pan recompute. Audacity SpecCache::Populate/CalculateOneSpectrum computes ONE windowSize FFT per DISPLAY column at from=where[0]+xx*samplesPerPixel (samplesPerPixel=sampleRate/pixelsPerSecond), so FFT count = display width, independent of clip length -> instant zoom. Plan: add a display-resolution STFT path to the worker (compute emittedColumns FFTs at stride spanSamples/emittedColumns, reuse Opt-B parallel pool + Opt-A magnitude-only, map to viewBinCount display bins, drop full-res EnsureRange+pyramid for zoomed views; zoom0/full-res path unchanged); keep W3 + SF11.2 caches + pan copy-range reuse. Tradeoff accepted: zoomed-out views approximate (skip samples between columns), exactly Audacity's behaviour. Expected cold overview ~3.9s -> <~100ms. Worker rebuild+rebundle+tests+re-profile+UI verify. APPROVAL GATE before implementing.

Owner addition 2026-07-03 (Phase 11 item 1): audit SpectrogramSettingsPanel (and spectrogram controls) for hardcoded/untranslated strings and route them through i18n (en/ru) so the whole Параметры panel is localized.

Owner addition 2026-07-03 (Phase 11 item 2): spectrogram caching is not actually working - switching A->B->A recomputes A from scratch (SF7.3 warm LRU not reused). Find why the reuse path misses (cache key mismatch, close/dispose evicting, per-socket session lifecycle, or UI reopening with changed params) and make returning to a recent file skip the re-decode/STFT.

Owner addition 2026-07-03 (Phase 11 item 3): speed up tile generation (Audacity is faster on the same files). Step 1: profile OUR get-tile pipeline (worker STFT-on-demand + tile build + JSON/WS + UI raster) and apply wins, then owner verifies. Step 2 (only if step 1 insufficient): study Audacity 3.7.8 sources at c:\projects\KKMindWave\SpectrumCore\lib\vendor\audacity\3.7.8 to learn why it is faster and port the approach.
Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 10): the area/point readout (peak dB / value under the pointer) is shown as a tooltip at the mouse position on the plot, not in the header or the bottom bar.
Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 9 item 1): remove border-radius on the spectrogram track block (.spectrogram-view) -> square corners like Audacity.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 9 item 2): a 2px horizontal divider between adjacent tracks; dragging it MUTUALLY resizes the two (track above and below change in opposite directions, combined height ~constant). Requires per-track heights (not one shared value). NOTE: owner wrote 'одна уменьшается, вторая уменьшается' - interpreted as one shrinks / other grows (standard boundary drag); confirm if different.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 9 item 3): the resize area at the bottom of the LAST track resizes ALL tracks by the same amount (equal heights), unlike the divider (mutual). Move resize handling to the AudioPage stack (per-track dividers + one bottom handle); SpectrogramView takes height as a plain prop, retiring its SF5.2 self-resize handle.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 8 item 1): Audacity-style multi-track chrome. For >1 track (stereo): control icons/toolbar (zoom/fit/range/readout) on the FIRST track only; per-track bottom resize handle; UNIFIED span/area selector across all tracks (selection on any track applies to + renders on all -> lift selection state to parent/shared store); remove inter-track chrome/gap so tracks abut. Guard: per-track click->seek + hover readout still correct.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 8 item 2): adaptive frequency-axis tick density. Reveal more level labels as the track height grows (fewer when short), like Audacity, instead of a fixed ~6 ticks; derive the tick target from plot height.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (Phase 8 item 3) DECIDED = option (a): build only on explicit user action - tree file click (RF4.1) or switching TO the Спектрограмма sub-tab - NOT on tab/page mount for a restored selection. Implementation: drop immediate:true from the SF4.1 ensureSpectrogramPrepared watch so it fires only on subsequent changes, not on mount.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (item 1): non-blocking load progress. On file select, render the tracks (spectrogram/schedule) view immediately + a small Audacity-style progress dialog OVERLAY while decode/prepare runs, instead of the full-panel 'Загрузка…' placeholder that hides the tracks.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (item 2) DECIDED = option (b) 'never recompute on resize'. Make viewBinCount a fixed constant (decoupled from track height; e.g. 512): a height-only resize leaves the view (time window+zoom+viewBinCount) unchanged so the setView no-op guard skips refetch, and the raster just scales to the new height (drawImage already stretches to plotH). Tradeoff accepted: enlarging shows fixed-resolution raster stretched (slightly softer). Width/time zoom still refetch.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (item 3): cache spectrograms across file switches. Opt C made analyses lazy (samples-only ~350MB, no matrix), so keep an LRU of a few open worker analyses keyed by file+params (switching back reuses; evict oldest, bounded by memory). Alt: client-side tile cache keyed by file+params. Recommend worker-analysis LRU; cap refined at execution.

Owner addition 2026-07-02: performance optimization approach A->B->C, each measured + UI-verified before the next. A (SF6.2): skip computing/storing phase + unwrapped-phase unless the data mode needs them (default magnitude doesn't) -> removes ~350M ArcTan2 + per-frame unwrap + 2 of 3 ~1.4GB matrices. B (SF6.3): multithread the independent per-frame FFT loop (per-thread FFTW plan/buffers). C (SF6.4): lazy/progressive per-visible STFT with a bounded cache (Audacity-style). All are worker (Pascal) changes -> rebuild + re-bundle + backend restart; per-step commit; pause for manual UI verification each. Owner: plan all three, implement A first with a UI-verification pause.

Owner addition 2026-07-02 (SF2.1 real concern = SPEED): the only-last-frame visual bug is resolved; the remaining SF2.1 problem is spectrogram GENERATION SPEED (Audacity is much faster). PROFILE FIRST, optimize second (approval gate before any optimization). Measure each pipeline stage on d:\bin\Presets\1_Orientation.flac: worker open-analysis, per-tile get-tile (sample-load/FLAC-decode vs FFT), tile payload bytes + JSON serialize/parse, WS transfer, UI render. Suspects to confirm/refute: single-threaded worker FFT; JSON (not binary) tile transport of large float arrays; repeated per-request FLAC decode (worker reads FLAC directly, no cached PCM).

Owner addition (Audacity-like UI #3): split stereo into stacked Left-over-Right panes, each analysing one channel (channel:0/channel:1, its own worker analysis); mono = single pane. Detect channel count from the decoded AudioBuffer.numberOfChannels (audio.spectrogramBuffer); label panes L/R. PREREQUISITE discovered at execution: the server kept one SpectrogramSession per WS and it was single-analysis (a 2nd open closed the 1st; get-tile used the session's stored analysisId). Refactored SpectrogramSession to hold multiple concurrent analyses keyed by analysisId (worker already multiplexes; client msgs already carry analysisId), so two channel analyses coexist over one socket. Backend change -> server restart.

Owner addition 2026-07-01: prepare the spectrum when the Спектрограмма tab is opened. The tab renders only when audio.spectrogramBuffer!=null; RF4.1 decodes on tree selection, but selecting a file on the Воспроизведение tab then switching to Спектрограмма (or a selected-but-undecoded file) leaves the stale 'start local playback' message with nothing happening. Fix: when the Спектрограмма view becomes active for a selected LOCAL audio file (wav/flac) with no decoded buffer and no decode in flight, trigger audio.ensureLocalAudioReady(selectedPath, kind) (same non-playback decode as RF4.1); update the obsolete audio.noSpectrogram wording to cover only the no-file-selected case. .gnaural unchanged.

steps.title: Plan & ledger
steps.verify: ledger JSON parses; dependsOn DAG acyclic; plan + ledger committed
evidence: Grounded in code: item1 = spec.loading exists in use-spectrogram.ts but SpectrogramView never surfaces it; AudioPage only shows audio.spectrogramLoading (decode). item2 = tiling/cache sound, analysisParams/renderOptions stable computeds; owner repro = on OPEN, one-tile strip runs L->R, only last tile stays -> rendered set holds one tile at a time; leading cause = view/seq/viewBinCount churn (ResizeObserver + double applyView) so assembleVisibleTiles matches only the newest tile. item3 = SpectrogramSettingsPanel is a fixed 264px column in AudioPage; mirror GnauralScheduleView settings overlay.
DAG acyclic: SF0.1 -> SF0.2 -> {SF1.1, SF2.1, SF3.1}.

steps.title: Loading indicator during spectrogram preparation
steps.verify: an overlay spinner shows while spec.loading (analysis open/reconfigure + tiles pending) and clears when ready; vue-tsc clean
evidence: SpectrogramView: added isPreparing = computed(spec.loading) and an absolute overlay (spectrogram-view__loading) with q-spinner-hourglass + label shown while preparing; container set position:relative. i18n audio.spectrogramPreparing added (en 'Preparing spectrogram…' / ru 'Подготовка спектрограммы…').

FOLLOW-UP FIX (owner: spinner never appeared): spec.loading originally reflected only pending tiles, so it stayed false during the slow worker open()/reconfigure() analysis and tiles arrived too fast to show. use-spectrogram.ts now tracks an `opening` flag set at the start of open()/reconfigure() (updateLoading -> loading=true) and cleared when refetch() starts (then loading = pending tiles) or on error/close. The indicator now covers the whole prepare span (open analysis -> first tiles).
vue-tsc clean; GnauralCore bun 56/0. Live-verify in quasar dev (owner).

steps.title: Fix only-last-frame render (persist/accumulate tiles)
steps.verify: opening a file renders the whole spectrogram and it stays (no single-tile strip / only-last-frame); pan/zoom still work; new composable unit test (tiles accumulate across binCount/seq change) green; vue-tsc + bun green
evidence: Root cause (reasoned): tiles were cached keyed on viewBinCount and the render only used the EXACT-key tile for the current view; during initial load the canvas height settles (ResizeObserver + double applyView), so viewBinCount/tile-keys churn (viewSeq bumps) and assembleVisibleTiles matched only the newest-fetched tile -> a single strip that runs L->R and leaves only the last tile.

Fix (SF-D3): (a) SpectrogramTileCache.getByTileIndex(analysisId, zoom, tileIndex) returns any cached tile for that tile regardless of binCount; assembleVisibleTiles now uses exact key OR this fallback so already-fetched tiles keep rendering across a binCount change. (b) tile arrivals ALWAYS re-assemble (dropped the pending.seq===viewSeq gate for assembly; seq still used for loading). (c) setView no-ops when the view (time window + zoom + viewBinCount) is unchanged, killing redundant applyView/ResizeObserver churn. (d) SpectrogramView rounds viewBinCount to a 32-step so small height jitter doesn't change keys.

Guarded by unit tests: SpectrogramTileCache.getByTileIndex (fallback, MRU preference, prefix-boundary, and an explicit only-last-frame regression case where tiles 0..2 fetched at binCount 128 all still resolve when the plan asks for 256). vue-tsc clean; GnauralCore bun 60 pass / 0 fail (+4). Final visual confirmation = owner (quasar dev).

FOLLOW-UP (owner screenshot: still a strip running L->R that vanishes, spinner stuck): the REAL root cause was planVisibleTiles nartitioning by a FIXED 256 full-res frames per tile REGARDLESS of zoom, so a full view of a long file (25 min) plans hundreds of full-res tiles that overflow the 128-entry LRU cache -> earlier tiles evicted, only the most-recent (rightmost) survive to render, and tiles never stop fetching (spinner stuck). Fix: planVisibleTiles now spans tileFrames*2^zoom full-res frames per tile, so a zoomed-out view needs only a handful of tiles (e.g. ~4-8) that fit the cache and all render/persist. Added a unit test (zoom 3 over a 100-tile file -> 13 bounded tiles, stepping by 256*8). vue-tsc clean; bun 61/0.

steps.title: Split stereo into left/right tracks
steps.verify: stereo files render stacked Left/Right per-channel panes (channel 0/1, separate analyses); mono renders one pane; channel count from AudioBuffer.numberOfChannels; panes labelled L/R; vue-tsc + bun green
evidence: SERVER (enabling change): SpectrogramSession now keeps a Map<analysisId,{wavHandle,params}> instead of a single analysis — onOpen no longer closes the previous (acquires its own source; releases on failure); get-tile/point-query/area-query use the message's analysisId (requireAnalysis(id) validates against the map); reconfigure targets the message's analysisId (close+reopen -> new id, keeps the source); close/dispose close per-analysis. server tests 17/0.

UI: AudioPage renders two stacked SpectrogramViews for stereo (isSpectrogramStereo = spectrogramBuffer.numberOfChannels>=2) with per-channel analysis computeds (spectrogramLeftAnalysis channel:0 / spectrogramRightAnalysis channel:1, stable computeds so no reconfigure churn), labelled L/R; mono renders one pane. Both share v-model:height (resize both). SpectrogramView gained a `label` prop shown in its toolbar.
Backend change -> requires bun server restart. vue-tsc clean; GnauralCore bun 61/0.

FOLLOW-UP: the WORKER was also single-analysis (EnsureCurrent errored on a non-current id -> owner saw 'get-tile analysisId mismatch' on the L channel). SpectrumCoreFftwWorkerProbe.pas now keeps a registry of analyses; EnsureCurrent selects by id + restores that analysis's cache token; open registers (no longer frees the previous), close unregisters, shutdown frees all. Rebuilt + re-bundled (manifest updated; exe gitignored). Verified: two opens then get-tile on the first -> ok; bridge test 15/0.

steps.title: Profile the spectrogram generation pipeline
steps.verify: stage-by-stage timing + payload breakdown on d:\bin\Presets\1_Orientation.flac (open-analysis, get-tile sample-load vs FFT, tile bytes + serialize/parse, WS, UI render); bottleneck named; owner approval gate on the fix
evidence: Recon: for wav/flac the source path passes STRAIGHT to the worker (worker decodes flac natively). Tiles transfer as JSON.

PROFILED d:\bin\Presets\1_Orientation.flac (33 min, 171144 frames, 2049 bins, 44.1k) via a stdio harness against a temporarily-instrumented worker: open-analysis = 22.2 s TOTAL = FLAC decode 3.4 s + STFT loop 18.8 s (DOMINANT). Full-view get-tile set (3 tiles) = 2.3 s wall, payload 1.59 MB, JSON parse 7 ms. Re-fetch not cached (~0.8 s).

BOTTLENECK = the eager full-file STFT loop in TFftwAnalysis.Create (SpectrumCoreFftwAnalysis.pas). It computes + stores magnitude AND phase AND unwrapped-phase for EVERY frame (ArcTan2 per bin ~350M calls + UnwrapFramePhases per frame) into 3 x ~1.4 GB matrices, EVEN when data=magnitude (default) -> phase/uphase work is entirely unused. Transport (JSON/WS) and get-tile are NOT the bottleneck.
Instrumentation was temporary (StdErr timers) and has been reverted; worker rebuilt + re-bundled clean.

PROPOSED FIXES (owner gate): (A) low-risk quick win: skip phase/unwrapped-phase compute+store unless data mode needs them (phase/uphase) -> removes ~350M ArcTan2 + unwrap + 2/3 of the ~4GB memory writes for the default magnitude mode; expected large cut of the 18.8 s. (B) multithread the frame loop (frames independent) -> ~/cores. (C) architectural: lazy/progressive per-visible STFT (Audacity-style). Recommend A first (biggest bang/lowest risk), then measure, then consider B.

steps.title: Optimization A: skip unused phase work
steps.verify: worker computes/stores phase + unwrapped-phase only when the data mode needs them; magnitude/reassign/pitch modes skip ArcTan2 + unwrap + the 2 phase matrices; point/area-query phase reads guarded; open-analysis time drops (re-profile on 1_Orientation.flac); PAUSE for manual UI verification (spectrum still correct)
evidence: TFftwAnalysis.Create: added NeedPhase = (DataMode in [admPhase, admUnwrappedPhase]); phase/unwrapped-phase arrays are allocated + the ArcTan2 + PhaseDest/UnwrappedPhaseDest stores + UnwrapFramePhases run only when NeedPhase (magnitude/reassign/pitch skip them). Magnitude (sqrt) is computed unchanged. Nil-guarded PhaseAt/UnwrappedPhaseAt (return 0 when the array wasn't allocated) so point-query still fills phase fields safely.
RE-PROFILE on 1_Orientation.flac: open-analysis 22.2s -> 6.2s (~3.6x); the ~16s of phase work removed (decode 3.4s + magnitude loop ~2.8s). get-tile unchanged (~2.2s), magnitude tiles byte-identical.

Correctness: magnitude point-query valid db/displayDb/magnitude (phase now 0, acceptable in magnitude mode); phase-mode get-tile still returns real phase values. GnauralCore bridge + session integration tests 17/0 against the re-bundled worker. Worker rebuilt + re-bundled (manifest refreshed). Requires backend restart. Owner UI verification = the pause.

steps.title: Optimization B: multithread the STFT loop
steps.verify: per-frame FFT loop parallelized across threads (per-thread plan/buffers); output identical; open-analysis time ~/cores (re-profile); PAUSE for manual UI verification
evidence: Added TStftFrameWorker(TThread) + ComputeStandardStftParallel: the standard STFT (magnitude + optional phase) is split into contiguous frame ranges across TThread.ProcessorCount workers (capped 32), each owning its own FFTW plan + in/out buffers (plans created serially in the main thread; execution on distinct plans/buffers is thread-safe; frame output rows are disjoint). Reassignment stays SERIAL (it scatter-writes to arbitrary CorrectedFrame -> races); pitch EAC pass unchanged.

RE-PROFILE on 1_Orientation.flac (16 logical CPUs): open-analysis 6.2s -> ~3.06s (now decode-bound; STFT loop ~near-zero). Cumulative A+B: 22.2s -> 3.06s (~7x). Tile payloads byte-identical to the serial build (606.1/608.8/373.3 KB) -> magnitude output unchanged.

get-tile rose ~2.2s -> ~3.5s in the same runs, but that is environmental (the app + quasar dev + backend all competing for CPU during the test); open-analysis is stable across repeats. get-tile does no FFT (pools the precomputed matrix), and B only changes how that matrix is filled (identical data).

Correctness: GnauralCore bridge + session integration tests 17/0 against the re-bundled worker. Worker rebuilt + re-bundled (manifest refreshed). Requires backend restart. Owner UI verification = the pause.

steps.title: Optimization C: lazy/progressive per-visible STFT
steps.verify: open-analysis no longer allocates the full-file matrix (no OOM on 1_Orientation.flac stereo); STFT computed on demand for the requested frame range (parallel) into a transient buffer; magnitude output identical; re-profile memory + speed; PAUSE for manual UI verification
evidence: IMPLEMENTED. TFftwAnalysis is lazy for magnitude/phase/uphase/pitch (reassignment stays eager): Create keeps the decoded samples + window LUT + eager FFrameTimes and allocates NO full matrix. EnsureRange(start,count) computes that frame range in parallel (ComputeStandardStftParallel refactored to write a frame range into caller buffers) into a transient FRangeMag(+phase); FMagnitudeData/FPhaseData/FUnwrappedPhaseData are set to BIASED pointers (buf - start*spec) so all absolute-frame readers work unchanged. WriteTileResponse / PointQuery / AreaQuery / export-matrix call EnsureRange then ClearRange (transient, freed after). Destroy frees the range buffers + samples for lazy (biased pointers are not separately owned).

RE-PROFILE on 1_Orientation.flac: open-analysis 2.6s (decode-only, no matrix); full-view tiles ~2.7s (computed on demand, parallel); tile payloads byte-identical (magnitude correct). Two concurrent channel analyses (stereo) open with NO matrix -> OOM path removed (open no longer allocates ~1.4GB/analysis). Peak memory ~= samples + one transient range (freed) instead of persistent full matrices.
GnauralCore bridge + session integration tests 17/0 against the re-bundled lazy worker. Requires backend restart. Owner UI verification (open 1_Orientation stereo -> no OOM) = the pause.

Chosen fix (owner): C. OOM cause = eager full-file magnitude matrix (~1.4GB/analysis; stereo 2x + browser decode -> OOM). Design: TFftwAnalysis becomes LAZY for magnitude/phase/uphase/pitch (reassignment stays eager - it scatter-writes across all frames). open keeps the decoded samples + window LUT + eager FFrameTimes but allocates NO matrix. EnsureRange(start,count) computes that frame range in parallel (reuses the B worker pool) into a transient FRangeMag(+phase) buffer; FMagnitudeData is set to a BIASED pointer (FRangeMag - start*spec) so all existing absolute-frame readers work unchanged. WriteTileResponse / PointQuery / AreaQuery call EnsureRange for their span then ClearRange. Peak memory ~= samples + one transient range (freed after) instead of a persistent full matrix.

steps.title: Match Audacity default spectrogram settings

steps.title: Fix spectrogram caching across file switches
steps.verify: A->B->A reuses the warm analysis (no full recompute); root cause identified; server tests green; owner verifies
evidence: ROOT CAUSE: SF7.3's warm-analysis LRU DID work (skips re-decode; the reuse test passes), but Opt C (SF6.4) made the STFT lazy -> every get-tile recomputes the STFT for the requested range. On a file switch A->B->A the client re-fetches all tiles (its per-composable tile cache is cleared on unmount), and the worker recomputes each -> the spectrum visibly rebuilds. So the *analysis* was cached but the *tiles* were not.

FIX: added a per-warm-analysis server-side computed-tile cache in SpectrogramSession (CachedAnalysis.tiles Map keyed by zoom|timeStart|timeEnd|viewBinCount, rounded; insertion-order LRU, cap TILE_CACHE_MAX_PER_ANALYSIS=64). onGetTile serves a cached tile without touching the worker; on miss it fetches + stores + bounds. The cache lives with the warm analysis (kept across close; freed on eviction/reconfigure/dispose), so returning to a file (same analysisId) or re-panning to a seen view is instant.

New unit test (mock worker manager + audio source, no exe needed): two identical get-tile requests -> the worker computes only once (getTileCalls==1); a different view range recomputes (==2). GnauralCore server tests 31/0 (was 30 + new). Backend change -> restart. Owner UI verification (A->B->A returns without rebuilding) = the gate.

steps.title: Profile + speed up tile generation
steps.verify: get-tile pipeline profiled, bottleneck named, wins applied; owner verifies speed; if insufficient, Audacity 3.7.8 study is the next step
evidence: PROFILED both by code analysis AND a live stdio harness on 1_Orientation.flac (33min, 171144 frames, bins 2049). MEASURED single-tile get-tile (viewBinCount 512): open-analysis(decode) 2685ms; whole-clip overview zoom=10 (emit 168 cols) COLD 3949ms / worker-W3-repeat 863ms; 120s window zoom=5 (emit 324) 668ms / 455ms; 2s window zoom=0 (emit 174) 247ms / 218ms. NOTE: a naive zoom=0 whole-clip tile emits 171144x512=87M JSON floats and hangs for minutes - but the client never does that (viewportZoomTier picks a high zoom for wide views), so it is not a real bug.

BOTTLENECK = per-tile STFT recompute on a cache miss. HandleGetTile maps the tile's (timeStart,timeEnd) to FULL-RESOLUTION frames (FrameCount = whole span at hop resolution); WriteTileResponse calls EnsureRange(frameStart, frameCount) which computes every one of those FFTs (Opt C lazy), then the TOverviewPyramid max-pools to the zoom tier. So a full-view overview recomputes the ENTIRE file's STFT. Interpolation + JSON emit are secondary.

KEY INSIGHT from the numbers: the worker's own whole-tile cache (TileResultCache/W3) 'repeat' is STILL 863ms for the overview because it caches FULL-RESOLUTION values (AFrameCount x bins) and REBUILDS the max-pool pyramid + re-emits JSON every call. APPLIED WIN (SF11.2): a server-side cache of the FINAL emitted tile (168 cols) in front of the worker -> a re-fetch skips the worker round-trip, the pyramid re-pool AND the JSON entirely (instant). So SF11.2 removes the ~0.9s/tile re-pool the user saw as 'rebuilding', not just the decode.

FIRST-GEN (cold) of an unseen overview = ~3.9s = the whole-file STFT (EnsureRange over all 171144 frames) - already A+B+C optimized (phase-skipped, multithreaded, lazy). REDUNDANCY vs Audacity: because EnsureRange computes per-tile over full-res frame ranges, different zoom levels / overlapping pans recompute the SAME underlying frames repeatedly; Audacity computes each frame once into a persistent per-clip SpecCache and never recomputes. So the deeper win = a bounded PERSISTENT per-frame STFT cache (cache computed full-res frames by frame index; EnsureRange only computes the missing ones) - a middle ground between Opt C (recompute-all) and the old eager full matrix (OOM).

RECOMMENDATION / NEXT (SF-D29 step 2, owner-gated): owner verifies SF11.2 first (A->B->A + re-pan should be instant now; the 863ms/tile re-pool is gone). If cold first-gen of fresh regions is still too slow vs Audacity, implement the persistent per-frame STFT cache (informed by Audacity 3.7.8 SpecCache at c:\projects\KKMindWave\SpectrumCore\lib\vendor\audacity\3.7.8). Not applied now (it's a worker rearchitecture with a memory-budget design that needs its own step + owner go).

ROOT CAUSE of the blank spectrogram tracks (regression from SF9.2's v-for). Console showed '[Vue warn] Invalid vnode type when creating vnode: null' in the spectrogram QTabPanel; a temp diagnostic proved spectrogramTracks=2 and heights=[338,338] with NO thrown error -> the tracks were in the vdom but never resolved. Cause: SpectrogramView is an ASYNC component (createAsyncAudioPanel, delay:120) that returns a NULL vnode during its loading-delay phase. Owner: left channel loaded but the RIGHT channel spun forever (no data, no error). Root cause: ws.ts dispatch() stops at the first handler returning true, and every spectrogram composable's onSpectrogram handler returned true -> the first-registered (left) view consumed ALL spectrogram messages (filtering by requestId), so the second (right) view's handler was never called and its open/tile responses never arrived. Fix: multicast spectrogram messages to a dedicated Set of subscribers (all views receive every spectrogram message); regular ServerEvents keep single-consumer dispatch. UI-only change (HMR / page reload; no backend restart). vue-tsc clean; ui 61/0.
